name: Cornelia
source: Cornelia is an aide in Eiserne Jungfrau, and a third-class priest. She has a strong sense of justice, but despite her cold exterior shared by her comrades, she is quite hot-blooded in nature. Cornelia is new to Eiserne Jungfrau and is innocent and unaware of the dark side of her profession. She was chosen for her current mission specifically by Gertrude. She was chosen so that she could decide if she was the right type of person for this profession.
